question: Should OpenClaw accept this redesigned Control UI chat composer, including the grouped provider/model picker, unavailable-model filtering, and voice/settings consolidation, as the product direction?
rationale: The code path is coherent and well-covered, but tests cannot decide whether this broader composer UX and model-choice policy should replace the already-merged smaller composer redesign for existing users.

options.title: Accept This Redesign
options.body: Merge after maintainer visual review if this is the desired composer, Settings, voice, and grouped model-picker direction.

options.title: Split Provider Compatibility
options.body: Ask for the composer layout and the availability/provider-normalization behavior to land separately with narrower upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause For UX Direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer the merged smaller composer design or want a different grouped-picker UX first.

recommendation.title: Accept This Redesign
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer visual review if this is the desired composer, Settings, voice, and grouped model-picker direction.
